notes.title: Update Notes for Version 1.1
notes.content:
[h1][u][b]Update Notes for Version 1.1[/b][/u][/h1]
Thank you to all the players for the feedback you've provided over the past two weeks. I have gathered some of the issues you raised and made adjustments to the game's program, which has led to this update. The specific updates are as follows:
[olist]
[*] 【New Feature】Hold the right mouse button or the RB button on the controller to zoom in the view.  
[*] Optimized some UI and sound effects of the launcher.  
[*] Improved the effects during scene changes in LV5.  
[*] After the end credits finish playing, the game will now automatically return to the main menu.  
[*] A signboard in the LV12 scene was previously untranslated, which has now been fixed.  
[*] Fixed a bug where the elevator door at the end would not close.  
[*] Adjusted the brightness of the red room (increased brightness).  
[*] Slightly reduced the difficulty of the LV11 level.  
[*] Fixed a bug where the button prompt submenu in the menu interface could be triggered incorrectly.  
[*] Possibly resolved an issue in LV13 where the character might fall infinitely with a small probability (maybe).
[/olist]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45379847/d20713624cacc12095a0c9103edc66b51d21cc72.png[/img]
